native_transport.note: Task names returned as native handles. No effective-model/effort or token telemetry exposed. Message text retained exactly; receipt timestamps are parent landing times. Tool envelopes are summarized here, not represented as complete internal traces.
native_transport.reader-04: spawn_agent; followup_task for first and second deliveries after native task completion; send_message for third delivery while running. Second logical request had MESSAGE, supplemental disclosure, and repeated FINAL_ANSWER. All retained; no duplicate documents served.

limitations: No backend model/effort or full tool-trace evidence exposed.

Four logical answer exchanges per subject. Reader-04 has two additional native messages within a request exchange; strict message-count interpretation exceeds five messages, while native task-turn count and paired exchanges do not. Report as protocol qualification, not hidden zero cost.
